driver_of_the_day.label: +11.1 pts v expected
driver_of_the_day.why: Lando Norris scored 25 from P1 on the grid; the model expected 13.9.

best_drive_from_back.label: P21 to P2
best_drive_from_back.why: Max Verstappen gained 19 places from P21 in the 4th-fastest car.

best_strategy.label: +4.3 places through the stops
best_strategy.why: Liam Lawson's 3-stop race cost 4.3 fewer places in the pit windows than the race's average stop.

fastest_stop.label: 2.1 s stationary
fastest_stop.why: Audi turned Gabriel Bortoleto round in 2.1 s on lap 32.

overtake_of_race.label: on Isack Hadjar, lap 10
overtake_of_race.why: George Russell passed Isack Hadjar for P3 on lap 10 despite being +1.07 s/lap slower on corrected pace.

smoothest.label: 1.158 s lap-time sd
smoothest.why: Alexander Albon's corrected clean laps varied by just 1.158 s (1 sd).

team_of_weekend.label: +17.2 pts v expected
team_of_weekend.why: Red Bull's drivers beat the model's expectation by 17.2 points combined.
